{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Rogue Squadron, Three Diamonds Parade Formation, execute!|Wedge Antilles to Rogue Squadron|<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>}}
The '''Three Diamonds Parade Formation''' was an intricate [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] parade formation used to demonstrate a squadron's precision flying. The squadron would divide into three [[Flight group/Legends|flights]] and form a triangle with one flight in front and the two behind. On each flight, the starfighters would form into a diamond shape formation with one in front, one in the back and two in the middle. Throughout all this, all of the starfighters would be facing the same direction.

==History==
{{Quote|A little wobbly, Hobbie."<br />"We haven't been together that long, Wedge, but we still know a few tricks. And you started this. Red Group Three, deny Rogue Group One!|Wedge Antilles to Derek Klivian|<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />}}
When [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after successfully [[Battle of Thyferra|liberating]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] from [[Ysanne Isard]], they found themselves escorted by a squadron that also identified itself as Rogue Squadron. Led by [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]], he explained that when the original Rogues resigned their commissions to wage their [[Bacta War|war]] on Isard, the [[New Republic Provisional Council|Provisional Council]] had the second squadron created in order to keep up appearances, as Rogue Squadron was a symbol to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />

On their way to the [[Imperial Plaza (Imperial Palace)|Imperial Plaza]], where an audience of civilians were waiting for their arrival; the original Rogue Squadron engaged the other squadron in a showmanship of precision flying. Using the Three Diamonds Parade Formation, the two squadrons thrilled the crowd with their flight formations; constantly trying to block or deny each one's landing.<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />
